rows.behavior: Workflow per document: upload, extract, shortlist, classify and choose, score, file or review, one final status

claims.claim: POST /documents takes the upload and saves raw bytes under their SHA-256 hash
Uploading the same bytes again returns the same document id
A workflow starts only for a document that is not already final
GET /documents/{id} returns status, reason and logged steps
An empty shortlist skips classify and choose and the category is misc
The model chooses only a provided record id or none
Approve with record_id files the document after review
Review actions are posted to /review/{id}/{action}
Dismiss needs a non-empty reason
An unanswered review expires after DOCKET_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, default 3600
docket reconcile starts missing workflows and marks abandoned documents failed (orphaned)
docket worker runs the worker
The workflow records the review-contract-v1 patch before its first activity
Blocking work runs in a thread so heartbeats keep flowing; the heartbeat timeout is 10 seconds

rows.behavior: Matching input budget, over-budget review with input_too_large, filename basename field, threaded batched shortlist

claims.claim: Body budget is 64,000 characters and 2,000 lines; subject 1,000; file name 255
File name budget is 255 characters
An over-budget body is left out of matching
Over budget sends the document to review with reason input_too_large
Record ids in every field still count toward a conflict
A strong match files only when its score reaches auto_file_threshold
auto_file_threshold is 0.5857142
Inside the budget, long tokens and lines are capped
Ids are still read from the full text and subject
A failpoint stops the process when DOCKET_FAILPOINT names it
Worker crash points are in the choose step and after storage
Worker crash after storage
API crash points after the raw file and after the document row
API crash after document insert
One test stops storage while a restarted worker runs
--fault includes tests/fault
CI runs ./verify.sh and ./verify.sh --fault

rows.behavior: Model gateway export/import modes, provenance, live per-document budget

claims.claim: The gateway has export and import modes
Live documents get their own run budget; evaluation runs share one
DOCKET_RUN_BUDGET_USD defaults to 2
DOCKET_DAILY_BUDGET_USD defaults to 1.50
Import validates all answers before saving any
A saved answer is never overwritten
A request key binds activity, prompt version, model and input
Already-recorded keys are kept, not replaced

rows.behavior: Evaluation, threshold tuning on seed 7, held-out replay gate, shadow diff

Threshold selection uses seed 7 and rules-only scores

Corpus includes graded evidence documents

Threshold 0.5857142 selected on seed 7
Floors computed at the configured threshold
Replay check compares metrics, results and provenance
